verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for an online government tax service such as MyFTB, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes recording Akamai 403 walls at the front door and at the application host. Neither says anything about retention policies or user-initiated deletion, so there is no evidence the product delivers this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
